facts.fact: REINA, the São Tomé and Príncipe network of business incubators and accelerators, with PNUD support ran the second Empreende+ competition: 33 of over 150 applicants got five weeks of intensive training and nine reached the final, with four funded.
facts.system: REINA (Rede de Incubadoras e Aceleradoras de Negócios de São Tomé e Príncipe)
